messages:
Sasha: Hey team — opening my first PR that tweaks a tiny helper in runtime. Two quick questions before I push: 1) any preferred branch prefix for small infra changes? 2) what's the absolute-minimum local check list to avoid wasting reviewers' time?

Leah: Welcome! For small infra we use `infra/short-desc` (e.g. `infra/kv-helper`). For feature work tracked in issues use `feature/ISSUE-####-short`. Keep names lowercase and hyphenated.

Victor: Minimal local checks I run: 1) pre-commit hooks `pre-commit run --all-files` 2) `make lint` (ruff/black/flake8) 3) focused unit tests `pytest tests/unit -k <file_or_marker>` 4) smoke the examples if you touched CLI. That catches 90% of CI noise.

Sasha: Thanks — do we require signed commits? And squash or merge commits?

Mira: Signed commits are optional day-to-day. For release branches we prefer signed. Merge style: squash + conventional commit. Final commit message should be like `fix(runtime): tighten kv helper` or `chore(infra): tidy helper` and include a small body with testing notes.

pre-commit-bot: Tip: if you get hook failures run `pre-commit run --all-files --hook-stage commit` locally, fix issues, then `git commit` again. Common failures: black formatting or ruff unused-imports.

Victor: For PR body, include a tiny template so reviewers can skim:
```
Summary: one-line
Why: short motivation
Change: 1-3 bullets
Tests: local commands you ran (pre-commit/lint/pytest) and brief results
Impact: low/medium/high
Rollout: how to canary / what to watch (metrics/logs)
```

Mira: Reviewers: check CODEOWNERS first. For runtime helpers ping @Mira and @Victor. If you touch docs also add @Leah. If you think it's urgent add label `priority/fast-review`.

Sasha: Any specific labels I should add up-front?

Leah: Add `release-note: none` for internal-only. If it touches perf, add `runtime-impact` and paste a quick bench (command + median). For experimental flags add `feature-flag: yes`.

ci-bot: If CI fails on a flaky job, comment `CI: flaky <job-name>` and tag me. To reproduce locally: `./scripts/ci_local_retry.sh <job-name>`. To re-run in GH Actions click "Re-run jobs".

Victor: One more habit that speeds reviews: keep diffs small (<300 lines), one responsibility per PR, and add an inline example command to exercise the change. Reviewers skim for the example first.

Sasha: Great — I'll branch `infra/kv-helper-sasha`, run pre-commit + make lint + focused pytest, paste the tiny PR template, and ping @Mira + @Victor. Thanks all :sparkles:
